search_parameters.algorithm: targeted U-03 root placement on each hypothetical shell edge, then deterministic tree-attached room placement and sampled public-route filtering
search_parameters.contact_sampling: Preserve the five legacy anchors; append the requested number of evenly spaced positions on each axis within the source 3.5ft door-reservation interval, snapped to the 1/6ft search grid.
search_parameters.public_door_edge_sample_basis: Hall reachability is tested at evenly spaced goal points along each room side, with each point kept at least half the source door-reservation interval from side corners. These are route samples only, not door locations or openings.

interpretation: Archive contains only complete packings with a non-null sampled hall-route result from this bounded run.
